I'm weighing whether to sell B&O for $550, since giving p3 all four railroads means $200 per hit at a landing rate that's fairly high across all four combined. With roughly 12% per turn chance of hitting any railroad and three opponents cycling through turns, that works out to around 0.4 landings per round, or about $80 per round in expected rent exposure.

P3 would end up with only about $335 cash left, leaving them too weak to build, while I'd still have $1679 to chase down color sets that remain mostly unowned. Since B&O alone isn't worth much to me, selling at a 175% premium seems smart, and blocking p3's monopoly isn't worth passing up that cash given rails pose little threat compared to hotels later on, so I'll accept the deal.
